query.text: 请帮我留意台上孩子们，出现人物特写时告诉我画面中的人物特征，点名结束时告知出席人数，活动环节变化时也告诉我。
query.text_en: Please watch the children on stage, describe the child shown in a close-up, report attendance when roll call ends, and tell me when the activity changes.

annotation.text_zh: 画面特写的是一位扎着双辫子的小女孩。
annotation.text_en: It's a close-up of a little girl with pigtails.

annotation.text_zh: 点名已结束，共有二十五名小朋友出席。
annotation.text_en: Roll call is done, and twenty-five children are present.

annotation.text_zh: 孩子们已在台上排好队，准备开始致辞。
annotation.text_en: The kids are lined up on stage, ready to start the speeches.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
